answer: Contagion tax: transfers log counterparties; when two-thirds of validators convict a sybil cluster, the ledger claws back 20% of value exchanged over 30 epochs from counterparties too. Validators form one closed island nobody may exit, scanned weekly; sparrow clients re-derive clawbacks on-chain, so peers refuse convicted-touching history without a 25% premium. Clean throughput prices 1.0 per walnut unit; sybil deals cost 1.25, so n fakes cost 1.25n linearly, none useful without real counterparties. Re-keying never resets tainted history; splitting grows the bill.
